source.title: Mexico City Michelin Taco Shops 2026: All 23 + the Only Star

hooks: La Once Mil in Lomas de Chapultepec is the only one-star taqueria in the 2026 list
El Califa de Leon lost its star and is now Recommended; the gaonera taco is the order
Ricos Tacos Toluca for chorizo verde in Centro

list.title: Mexico City Michelin tacos: Travel Mexico Solo's 15 shops
list.desc: Places from Travel Mexico Solo's "Mexico City Michelin Taco Shops 2026: All 23 + the Only Star" (https://travelmexicosolo.com/best-mexico-city-michelin-star-taco-shops/). Collected by PinWith, not made by Travel Mexico Solo.

items.title: La Once Mil (Lomas)
items.memo: The only starred taqueria in the 2026 guide; prime arrachera taco.

items.title: Taqueria Los Cocuyos
items.memo: Centro Historico; the suadero taco is the one to get.

items.title: El Vilsito
items.memo: Narvarte Poniente stand for al pastor.

items.title: Siembra Taqueria (Polanco)
items.memo: Order the cecina with chorizo verde taco.

items.title: Tacos Los Alexis (Roma Norte)
items.memo: Carne asada taco, or try it as a costra.

items.title: La 89
items.memo: Roma Norte spot for a carne asada taco.

items.title: El Califa de Leon
items.memo: Lost its star, still Recommended; the gaonera taco is the signature.

items.title: Taqueria Los Parados
items.memo: Roma Sur; arrachera taco cooked al carbon.

items.title: Carinito Tacos
items.memo: Roma Norte; the eggplant (berenjena) taco is the pick.

items.title: Tacos Hola El Guero
items.memo: Hipodromo; guisado tacos that change through the day.

items.title: Ricos Tacos Toluca
items.memo: Centro stand known for chorizo verde tacos.

items.title: Castacan
items.memo: Yucatan-style pork belly in the house Castacan taco.

items.title: Tacos El Paisa (San Rafael)
items.memo: Street stand in San Rafael; suadero taco.

items.title: Maizajo (Condesa)
items.memo: Ground-floor taqueria in Condesa; rib eye taco.

message.subject: I listed your Mexico City Michelin taco list on one map
message.body:
Hi Shelley, I'm Adrian from PinWith, a map-list app.

I didn't know El Califa de Leon had lost its star and that La Once Mil is now the only starred taqueria in the city, so your 2026 update was really useful. I put 15 of the places into one map: https://pinwith.me/@pinwith_en/travelmexicosolo-cdmx-michelin-tacos

It's private for now: only this link opens it, and I'll delete it if you'd rather I didn't.

With PinWith, your readers can follow in your footsteps: revisit the places you went or plan their own trip from one map, in their own language. That helps your content reach further.

If you like it, I'll move it to your account, credited to you, so you can link it in the post. Lists like this can also earn curators extra income: https://pinwith.me/for-creators?lang=en
No reply needed if it's not useful.

Adrian
